label: Every sentence the screen guide says from the server

params.name: no_tour
params.default: This screen has no guide yet.

params.name: bad_format
params.default: This is not a Guide me script: it must say "format": "guide-me/1".

params.name: no_title
params.default: The tour needs a title.

params.name: few_steps
params.default: A tour needs at least three steps.

params.name: step_no_title
params.default: Step {n} has no title.

params.name: step_no_say
params.default: Step {n} has nothing to say.

params.name: bad_art
params.default: Step {n} asks for a picture this guide cannot draw.

params.name: bad_place
params.default: Step {n} places its card on a side the guide does not know (below, above, right, left or center).

params.name: bad_icon
params.default: An icon name in this script is not one the portal has.

params.name: bad_portal
params.default: The script names a portal the Builder does not know.

params.name: bad_page
params.default: The page name may hold only small letters, digits, dashes and underscores.

params.name: bad_rate
params.default: The voice speed must be between 0.5 and 2.

params.name: bad_pitch
params.default: The voice pitch must be between 0 and 2.

params.name: list_must_open
params.default: The tour starts on a list but never opens an item, so every step about the inside would say "not on screen".

params.name: step1_must_open
params.default: Step 1 starts on the list, so it must also bring the list back (open the Home button) for someone who presses Back.

params.name: wrong_page
params.default: This script is for a different page. Import it on the page it names, or change its "page".

params.name: not_json
params.default: That is not a Guide me script: the file could not be read as JSON.

params.name: too_big
params.default: That script is larger than {kb} KB.

params.name: script_refused
params.default: The script was not imported - {n} thing(s) to fix.

params.name: chip_refused
params.default: The tour could not be saved as it stands.

params.name: nothing_imported
params.default: This page has no imported Guide me to take off.

params.name: chip_label
params.default: The step-by-step guide to {screen}: every step, spotlight, narration and picture

params.name: knob_title
params.default: The tour's name (its cover card)

params.name: knob_lede
params.default: The cover's opening line; {product} = this edition's name

params.name: knob_icon
params.default: The emblem on the cover (an icon name)

params.name: knob_minutes
params.default: How long the tour takes

params.name: knob_steps
params.default: The steps in order: title, say, target, art, place, open

params.name: knob_voice
params.default: This page's voice: overrides guide.settings for this tour only

description_nl: Sentences of core/guide.py, and the problems chip guide.check names ({n} = the step number).
